description.value:
Matangas are indigenous to the isle of Thavnair, imposing and pachydermic in form with dexterous prehensile trunks and a deep connection to the natural world.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Matangas gain +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Dexterity.
  • Size: Matangas are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Matangas are humanoids with the Matanga subtype.
  • Base Speed: Matangas have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Matangas begin play speaking Common and Matanga. Matangas with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Dwarven, Elvaan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Hardy: Matangas receive a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, spells, and spell-like abilities.
  • Powerful Build: Matangas function as one size category larger for many combat maneuver purposes.
  • Stability: Matangas receive a +4 bonus to CMD when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Academic: Matangas receive a +2 racial bonus on a Knowledge skill of their choice, treated as a class skill.
  • Craftsman: Matangas gain a +2 racial bonus to Craft checks.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Dexterous Trunk: Matangas can retrieve small, stowed objects as a swift action with their trunk.
  • Powerful Tusks: Matangas gain a gore attack, dealing 1d6 points of damage.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Matangas have low-light vision allowing them to see twice as far as humes in dim light.
